sentences.text: (PER: THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE HANCHATE SANJEEVKUMAR)
Though the appeal is listed under the caption hearing - interlocutory application, but with the consent of the learned counsel appearing for the parties, the same is taken up for final disposal.
2. The Special Land Acquisition Officer, UKP, Bilagi has preferred the appeal questioning the quantum of compensation, awarded by the reference Court and enhanced by the First Appellate Court.

3. The claimants are owners of the land and their lands were acquired for the purpose of Upper Krishna Project under the preliminary notification dated 18.01.2003 and award came to be passed on 11.11.2003.

The reference Court has ordered compensation of Rs.1,84,000/- per acre excluding poth kharab area, if any, the same is enhanced by the First Appellate Court and awarded compensation of NC: 2025:KHC-D:116 Rs.2,64,375/- per acre.
The appellant-SLAO has preferred the appeal on the ground that it is excessive.

4. This Court in MFA No.22347/2009 dated 14.06.2011 and in MFA No.20182/2010 connected with other cases dated 09.09.2011 has awarded a compensation of Rs.2,64,375/- per acre in respect of the very same project for other land losers who are also similarly situated on par with the claimants/land losers herein.
Therefore, the appeal is found to be devoid of merit so as to reduce the quantum of compensation.
Therefore, the compensation awarded by the First Appellant Court by determining Rs.2,64,375/- per acre is confirmed.
5. The claimants are entitled to all other statutory benefits, costs and interest as per law on the compensation amount determined by the First Appellate Court.
Accordingly, the appeal is dismissed.

Sd/-
(HANCHATE SANJEEVKUMAR) JUDGE RKM The Special Land Acquisition Officer vs Somappa Maliyappa Sonnad on 7 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109348494/
